data.title: 黑歌 · 月光寝榻薄纱睡裙的伸展猫姿
data.description: 夜深月明，黑歌在柔软床铺上舒展身姿，半透明黑色蕾丝睡裙轻拂肌肤，双耳轻抖，如夜猫般娇懒诱人。
data.action: 双手举过头顶舒展伸懒腰，纤腰微挺，猫尾在床单上俏皮划动
data.lighting: 窗外倾泻入内的清冷月光与床头微弱暖黄壁灯烘托轮廓
data.camera: 俯视微倾机位，展现柔韧身体线条与丝绸床品
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, kuroka, nekomata, black cat ears, twin tails, two black cat tails, golden eyes, sheer black lace babydoll negligee, translucent nightgown, stretching arms overhead on plush bed sheets, arching back gracefully, playful expression, soft moonlight filtering through sheer bedroom curtains, warm bedside lamp glow, sensual atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, kuroka, cat ears, two tails, sheer black babydoll negligee, stretching on bed under moonlight.
